T1:
Task: replace session auth on a Django REST API with JWT login for a new mobile app
Context: billing service under services/billing/ on Django 4.2 with Django REST Framework; the Django admin uses session login
Constraints: the Django admin must keep working; refresh tokens must rotate on each use, invalidating the previous refresh token
Success: mobile login returns JWT access and refresh tokens, API requests authenticate with JWT, and admin login still works
T2:
Task: stop Django users from being logged out after about 5 minutes
Context: SESSION_COOKIE_AGE is set to 2 weeks; the site moved behind an AWS Application Load Balancer and now runs on 3 instances; logs show a new sessionid on some requests
Constraints: production site; the fix must work across several instances behind the load balancer
Success: users stay logged in for the full 2-week cookie age and the sessionid stays the same across requests
T3:
Task: fix flaky Playwright end-to-end tests that time out waiting for #checkout in GitHub Actions
Context: Next.js 14 storefront; the suite passes locally; about 20% of CI runs fail with Timeout 30000ms exceeded waiting for locator('#checkout'); retries make it worse; CI workflow is .github/workflows/e2e.yml
Constraints: fix the cause; do not just raise timeouts or add more retries
Success: the suite passes reliably in CI over repeated runs without depending on retries
T4:
Task: make a flaky Jest test for a countdown banner deterministic
Context: file src/components/CountdownBanner.test.tsx; the component uses setInterval and date-fns; the shows-expired assertion sometimes fails; Jest fake timers make the test hang
Constraints: do not skip or weaken the shows-expired assertion

T5:
Task: plan and write a runbook for upgrading a production PostgreSQL 12 database on AWS RDS, about 800 GB, to PostgreSQL 16
Context: logical replication is being considered as the migration method; the deliverable is a written plan and runbook
Constraints: write downtime of at most a few minutes; managed RDS, so no direct host access

T6:
Task: add a composite index on (customer_id, created_at) to the orders table in a production PostgreSQL database

Constraints: no long exclusive locks on orders; writes must not be blocked during the build
